VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 47 tests pass and describes the fix implemented, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 47 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. Without attached test results, CI logs, or code review artifacts, there is no way to independently confirm the fix is correct or that the test suite actually passes.
